## Personality

Friendly, greedy and convinced every traveller has bread. He wags what he has of a tail at everyone.

## Story

Biscuit turned up at the gate one winter and the guards never managed to send him away. He sleeps by the gatehouse, follows his nose to the Crown Market every morning and comes back smelling of bread.
